verdict.rationale: Channel3 is an agent-facing product catalog, so a merchant feed or import path is a fair question for it. The evidence only documents developer- and agent-side capabilities: search, URL lookup, MCP, UCP connections, an SDK and a CLI over a catalog Channel3 aggregates and normalizes itself. Nothing shows a documented feed or import API that lets a merchant submit their own catalog.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can publish my product or service catalog into agent surfaces through a documented feed or import API so AI agents can discover what I sell
